slides.headline: He built an AI company from scratch. Jeff Bezos backed it. Forbes now values him at $2.1 billion.
Aravind Srinivas, co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, is worth $2.1 billion as of September 2026
slides.body: Born in Chennai, he holds a Bachelor's and Master's from IIT Madras and a PhD in Computer Science from UC Berkeley, with earlier research stints at OpenAI and Google DeepMind. He co-founded the AI search company Perplexity in August 2022.

slides.headline: A company that went from a $520 million valuation to $20 billion in under two years.
slides.body: Perplexity's valuation climbed from $520 million in January 2024 to $9 billion by December 2024, then $20 billion by late 2025 - backed by investors including Jeff Bezos, Yann LeCun and Google's chief scientist Jeff Dean. The company built its identity around citing sources directly in AI-generated answers, a deliberate bet against black-box search.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: An IIT degree used to be the credential people left India with. It's now the credential investors bet billions on.
slides.body: A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs its own technical education to be recognized as world-class capital, not just a launchpad abroad. Srinivas's IIT Madras training is exactly what the world's biggest investors are now backing at scale.
